label: High-risk system lifecycle assurance
bearer: Formal AI Act provisions governing high-risk systems
function_or_problem: Prevent, demonstrate and maintain conformity across lifecycle
component_relations_and_elements: C03 C04 C05; R01 R02 R04 R05; provider risk/QMS/documentation/logging/monitoring instruments; deployer use/oversight duties
authority_and_discretion_pattern: Operator duties are primary; notified-body authority enters through conditional Article 43 routes; deployer retains bounded organizational choice
accountability_pattern: Documentation, logs and reports feed authority review; formal procedural protections apply downstream
configuration_inference: Linked provider/deployer duties and conditional external assessment organize lifecycle governance; not inferred from frequency.

label: National market surveillance with Union safeguard and rights-authority links
bearer: Formal AI Act provisions governing market surveillance
function_or_problem: Detect and respond to risk/non-compliance in Union market
component_relations_and_elements: C06 C07 C09 C10 C12; R03–R08; national competent authorities, operators, fundamental-rights bodies, Commission; evaluation, information, corrective measures and safeguard procedure
authority_and_discretion_pattern: Member State authorities hold principal case-level surveillance powers; Commission has a bounded Union safeguard role; rights bodies retain mandate-specific access
accountability_pattern: Reasoned requests, notification, operator hearing/remedy protections and procedural rules create differentiated answerability/review
configuration_inference: Cross-provision links form a multilevel surveillance pathway while preserving distinct authority bases.

label: Commission-centered GPAI supervision and enforcement
function_or_problem: Assess GPAI provider compliance and systemic risk and take specified measures
component_relations_and_elements: C08 C10 C12; R09–R11; Commission/AI Office, provider, scientific panel and Board; information requests, evaluations, dialogue, mitigation and market measures
authority_and_discretion_pattern: Exclusive Commission supervision/enforcement for Chapter V, implemented by AI Office; panel alert and Board consultation/information have narrower roles
accountability_pattern: Provider procedural rights and review apply; notification and information links distinguish advisory inputs from decision authority
configuration_inference: Specific objects, powers and actor links warrant a distinct configuration within the Regulation.
